C0384.title: Qinghai Decoration Firm Absconds After Low-Price Renovation Contracts, Suspects Sentenced
C0384.summary: In 2024, Xining police cracked a contract fraud case. A decoration engineering company used false advertising and low-price tactics to lure homeowners into signing renovation contracts. After collecting deposits exceeding 50% of the contract value, the actual controller, knowing the company lacked the ability to perform, carried out only token construction before absconding with the funds.
